scope: 28 assigned subjects; mechanics survey, not full canon certification or gameplay implementation.

evidence_policy.verified_reference: A bounded statement supported by material returned this run; consult source access for page versus indexed excerpt.
evidence_policy.remembered_unverified: Prior recollection only. Not evidence for direct adaptation or top-15 recommendation.
evidence_policy.inference: Analytical mapping or derived use, not an assertion that the source uses E8 field names.
evidence_policy.proposal: Original what-we-take idea; not an accepted decision.
evidence_policy.not_found: No checked gag or loophole in this bounded source pass.
evidence_policy.null_slots: Absent or not established by reviewed evidence; never means a universal prohibition.

series.title: Worm

claims.text: Natural trauma triggers and administered formulas are distinct acquisition routes; powers ultimately involve Entity shards. Formula results and costs vary.
claims.locator: natural-triggers-and-formula-acquisition: W162-C01/02, W127-C03; cosmology: W281-C04/07, W291-C01/02

claims.text: PRT classes guide countermeasures, while numbers estimate threat to a response team, not a universal power level.
Emergency truces are negotiated and enforced by people. Local powers have distinct reach, fuel and material limits.

path.steps: Trigger then mastery; no common ladder

slots.restriction: Do not attack allies during emergency

vows.interpretation_trick: No verified loophole in this source selection.

mechanics.name: Assessment is a separate record
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: save who graded a power, what they saw and which response the grade recommends.

mechanics.name: Gift has its own agenda
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: separate source goals from user goals without treating every shard as collectible.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: Insect control can supply scouting and fine coordination as well as attacks. This is broad use of one gift, not another class unlocked by XP.
gag_or_rule_abuse.note: Operational profile, not a newly checked gag scene.

series.limits: No Worm sequel sweep or fresh whole-book claim. Shards here are not identical to E8 shards of a broken artifact.

series.title: Cradle

claims.text: Madra Paths climb Foundation, Copper, Iron, Jade, Gold and Lord stages. Lord gates require revelations. Sage and Herald are distinct achievements; Monarch joins them. Remnant absorption is one Gold route, not the only one.
Core splitting loses a small amount of energy and divides reserves; cores can advance independently. An advanced Remnant may resist or allow a bond.

vows.enforcement: Bond mechanics; exact breach penalty not established
vows.interpretation_trick: No verified loophole in this source selection.

mechanics.name: Split reservoir with shared body
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: track reservoir size, quality and refill separately from body rank.

mechanics.name: Converging achievements
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: allow insight and body transformation in either order before their joint gate.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: Splitting a core does not create free fuel: two smaller cores can house different Paths, with a slight loss at the split.

series.limits: Ranks summarized from references; no complete Path roster. Remnant identity is not automatically the dead person soul.

series.title: Mistborn

claims.text: Allomancy burns ingested metals. Feruchemy banks attributes in metal while weakening the same trait now; normal stores are personal. Hemalurgy steals and transfers power. These arts use metal differently.
Compounding combines matching-metal Allomancy and Feruchemy so outside energy amplifies the stored attribute. It is not ordinary storage creating energy.

path.branching: Single or many metals; Twinborn combinations

axes.persistence: Stores in metal; access in bearer

vows.interpretation_trick: No verified loophole in this source selection.

mechanics.name: Time-shift an attribute
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: let calm days fund a later burst through a real named store.

mechanics.name: Cross-system fuel loop
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: declare the external fuel and conversion rule that makes a storage combo multiply output.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: Matching arts can compound a store rather than merely return what was saved. The amplifier has an outside energy source.

series.limits: No complete sixteen-metal chart or universal inheritance rule. Later identity-free stores need separate era-specific proof.

series.title: The Stormlight Archive

claims.text: Spren bonds grant Surges through ten Orders with different Ideals. Lightweavers progress through personal truths rather than the same oath pattern as other Orders.
Breaking a developed bond can harm its spren. Deadeye creation is tied to the Ba-Ado-Mishram imprisonment era and bond stage, not every broken oath in all history.

path.ceiling: Order summit, not all cosmere power

vows.collective_rules: Shared Order themes, not one pooled vow
vows.interpretation_trick: No verified loophole in this source selection.

mechanics.name: Change through a promise
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: let a vow unlock a new function when a person proves growth, rather than always quoting a strength multiplier.

mechanics.name: Partner takes breach damage
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: assign breach victims separately from the swearer and keep era-specific sanctions.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: Personal truth supplies a progression route where a stock oath would be the wrong gate. This is a distinct Order rule, not cheating the oath system.

series.limits: Exact Ideal counts and new-era bond outcomes need source-era selection. No automatic universal deadeye rule.

series.title: The Kingkiller Chronicle

claims.text: Sympathy uses Alar to link objects and transfer force or energy, with losses including heat in the user. Naming instead depends on intuitive discovery of a true name; a spoken label alone is insufficient.

path.gate: Study for links, insight for Names
path.shape: Two distinct arts in open field

axes.visibility: Effect visible; link may be hidden

vows.collective_rules: Teaching institutions; no collective magical vow established
vows.interpretation_trick: No verified loophole in this source selection.

mechanics.name: Loss reaches the operator
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: put waste heat and control failure in a technique profile, so better links matter.

mechanics.name: Name is understanding
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: distinguish an ordinary label, a known true-name secret and the grasp needed to use it.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: An efficient link and an outside heat source could beat a larger personal reserve. This is a design inference, not a checked Kvothe scene.

series.limits: Fandom blocked. Exact slippage formula, Alar splitting limits and named duel tricks remain unverified; none supplied as canon.

series.title: The Dresden Files

claims.text: Faerie-office debts can survive a change of holder. Lea fulfilled Harry power bargain through confidence without increasing his actual powers.
The author says Soulfire and Hellfire are not additive; selection depends on user and purpose.
Remembered: Soulfire invests part of the caster soul into magic, with depletion risk and recovery. Exact cost and recovery are not verified in this pass.

slots.consequence: Claim or debt; exact punishment varies
slots.interpretation: Outcome may differ from expected means

vows.interpretation_trick: Confidence fulfilled Lea promise without a stat increase

mechanics.name: Office holds the claim
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: let a debt name an office so a new holder can collect it.

mechanics.name: Result versus method
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: record what was promised separately from how the patron fulfills it.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: The apparent power-up in Lea bargain was confidence. Killing or replacing a faerie office holder does not necessarily erase its claims.

series.limits: Do not source universal truth-binding from author folklore preamble. Soulfire soul cost is remembered only, not ready for direct recreation.

series.title: The Wheel of Time

claims.text: The One Power has saidin and saidar halves; saidin taint belongs to a specific history. The Oath Rod is a ter angreal binder; sworn acts can become impossible and binding reduces lifespan.
The truth oath follows what the speaker believes. Evasion is possible; the Rod can remove oaths. Oaths support institutional trust but do not grant channeling.

path.steps: Learning and strength, not universal XP

vows.collective_rules: Common oaths bind each member separately
vows.interpretation_trick: A false belief can be spoken without lying

mechanics.name: Cannot act versus pay after
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: make prevention and punishment separate enforcement modes.

mechanics.name: Belief as truth basis
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: let a local truth rule inspect belief rather than secretly reading objective world facts.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: A technically true or sincerely believed statement can mislead listeners despite the speech oath.

series.limits: Not all ter angreal are binders. No universal male/female stat rule or television-source blend.

series.title: A Practical Guide to Evil

claims.text: Names give access to up to three Aspects shaped by the person and the Name. A Role has causal weight beyond physical power.
Malicia and Bard discuss danger at the end of a pattern of three, and planning an attack before a Name settles. These are character tactical judgments, not guaranteed results.

path.gate: Take a Role and develop it
path.ceiling: Three Aspects in reference; magnitude uncapped

vows.enforcement: Role mechanics; no breach schedule established
vows.interpretation_trick: No verified loophole in this source selection.

mechanics.name: Role selects affordances
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: let a title change eligible actions and counterplay as well as stats.

mechanics.name: Same title, different verbs
mechanics.what_we_take: Proposal: derive a few aspect verbs from lived choices, rather than issue every title holder identical skills.

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: Malicia and Bard plan around when a Name is vulnerable; Malicia pattern-of-three model is corrected in the conversation. Knowledge of story rules can be partial.
gag_or_rule_abuse.note: A checked plan and disagreement, not a proved automatic victory.

series.limits: No Jumpchain AP/CP budgets used. Role causality must not become global plot armor. Exact narrative outcomes still require scene-specific checks.

claims.text: Classes can consolidate, sometimes keeping multiple titles in one class. Lyonette lost Princess through role mismatch and regained it by redefining the role. System messages announce levels, class changes and more.

path.grader: Grand Design; society reads the label

axes.certainty: Message is an award, not full appraisal

One divine disclosure pact reads the bound person senses, thoughts and memories. A private authored research gift allows knowledge evasion without removing that pact.

path.steps: Mastery and loop access, no XP ladder
path.gate: Teachers, practice, ritual and marker access
path.risk: Soul scars; finite iterations; lost copies
path.branching: Structured spells, shaping and soul work

gag_or_rule_abuse.text: The disclosure pact can be evaded through how information reaches the bound person; the pact itself remains.

series.title: Dungeons & Dragons: 2024 revised fifth edition

claims.text: Warlocks gain Pact Magic and invocation choices through level gates and patron relations. The cited class rules do not specify automatic removal of all powers for displeasing a patron.

Wish duplicates spells of level eight or lower without their normal requirements. Other uses incur stress, including a 33 percent chance to lose Wish forever. Open-ended requests let the DM fail, partly grant or twist the result.

path.grader: Rules plus DM for open requests

top_15.name: Separate prevention, automatic penalty and later judgment
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D has a consequence slot but starts from breach then penalty. A blocked act has no committed breach; a court can impose one later.
top_15.proposal: Add enforcement.mode and an attempt/breach/verdict split.
top_15.smallest_proof: Attempt one blocked lie, break one punitive pact, face one alleged social breach. Logs must differ.

top_15.name: Give the witness a knowledge boundary
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D interpretation-by-tags cannot express a clause reading thoughts, memories or sincere belief.
top_15.proposal: Add truth_basis, observer, evidence_channels and check_time. Use wheel.C2 as the belief contrast.
top_15.smallest_proof: The same false statement passes a belief oath but fails an objective-fact rule; an undisclosed fact does not reach a limited witness.

top_15.name: Give the bargain an office holder
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D inheritance is present, but succession of the creditor office differs from inheriting a personal vow.
top_15.proposal: Add claim_holder_type and office_id; keep debtor, creditor and current holder distinct.
top_15.smallest_proof: Replace the office holder; the claim stays, without copying the old holder memories into the new one.

top_15.name: A real store plus an outside amplifier
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8B stored mode and Stat work exist. The new part is distinguishing ordinary banking from externally fueled multiplication.
top_15.proposal: Add fill_cost, balance, output_rate, converter and external_source to selected stores.
top_15.smallest_proof: A plain store pays only its balance; a declared second source amplifies output and spends its own fuel.

top_15.name: Reservoir size is not rank quality
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8C currency and steps exist, but a split reservoir should not lower its quality or double its fuel.
top_15.proposal: Separate capacity, balance, quality, refill and the common body gate.
top_15.smallest_proof: Split one store into two compatible sources with loss; advance one quality while the other remains unchanged.

top_15.name: Validate what a technique part can really modify
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8B composed delivery and E4 tags exist. PoE cautions that shared tags alone do not prove support compatibility.
top_15.proposal: Add a typed operation contract beside tags; compute resulting cost and failure reasons.
top_15.smallest_proof: A tag match without a supported operation stays invalid; one valid part changes only its linked methods.

top_15.name: Paid costs can feed another rule
top_15.delta_from_existing: The north star already has triggers and combos. The new work is an event order and a record showing that the cost was paid once.
top_15.proposal: Represent committed costs as events with provenance; distinguish legal in-world loops from duplicate replay.
top_15.smallest_proof: One exhausted option creates one draw; replaying the same receipt creates none; a new generated option can trigger its own legal chain.

top_15.name: Promise an outcome without promising its route
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D names a benefit but lacks a clear distinction between result, means and a person expectation.
top_15.proposal: Add promised_result, allowed_means and fulfillment_record; curses.C2 is a darker contrast.
top_15.smallest_proof: A patron fulfills promised courage through teaching or confidence. The record shows whether a stat increase was actually promised.

top_15.name: Separate payer, supplier and judge
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D patron/witness pricing and audience already exist. A sponsor can fund a gift that another authority controls.
top_15.proposal: Add reward_payer, reward_supplier and authorizer to selected grants.
top_15.smallest_proof: A sponsor funds a desired tool but dungeon rules reject its delivery; relationship and authorization remain separate.

top_15.name: Own, know, equip and activate are separate
top_15.delta_from_existing: Existing research already separates knowledge and execution. An inactive owned artifact adds a useful activation state.
top_15.proposal: Add activation_state and activator to item-source profiles, with explicit persistence.
top_15.smallest_proof: An owned rune is inspected, equipped and activated through distinct actions; possession alone does not apply its effect.

top_15.name: An oath gate can accept growth
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8C has release stages and E8D restriction pricing. A personal truth or accepted Ideal is not an interchangeable sacrifice quote.
top_15.proposal: Allow affirmation vows with acceptance_gate and milestone, no compulsory traded object.
top_15.smallest_proof: Repeating a truth without the relevant lived change gives no new stage. A different valid truth can qualify where local rules allow.

top_15.name: Make a counter match mechanism, not casting medium
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8 separates mechanism and trigger. The added detail is speech, writing and intent as different carriers of one method.
top_15.proposal: Record expression_medium, required_parts and permitted alternatives on a technique.
top_15.smallest_proof: Silence blocks voice casting; a source-permitted written version works at its own cost; an unpermitted alternative does not.

top_15.name: A grade is a scoped response policy
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8C already allows institutional grades. Worm adds what a grade tells a team to do, and whose evidence it used.
top_15.proposal: Store grader, purpose, evidence, date and recommended_response separately from real power.
top_15.smallest_proof: A scouting team and a duel school issue different assessments of the same power without changing its actual damage.

top_15.name: A release clause can be found
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D release and true-name families exist. Their combination makes investigating a secret a lawful contract exit.
top_15.proposal: Add release_predicate and discovery_state, with clause visibility separate from its secret answer.
top_15.smallest_proof: The player discovers the required name and fulfills the clause; inventing a wrong name does not release the claim.

top_15.name: Keep an impossible vow set impossible when local rules say so
top_15.delta_from_existing: E8D already lists collisions and the same geis tale. The refinement is not silently choosing a priority that saves the hero.
top_15.proposal: Add conflict_set, simultaneous_breaches and local_priority; allow no priority, negotiated waiver or escape by circumstance.
top_15.smallest_proof: A trap offers only acts that break a known duty; show the separate costs rather than auto-cancel one promise.

integration_proposals.title: Separate the power from reports about it
integration_proposals.proposal: Keep ten axes. Add an optional observation record with observer, source, belief/confidence, evidence time and hidden axes. Add expression medium to mechanism details. This supports Worm grading, belief oaths and Zatanna counters without another universal power tier.

integration_proposals.title: Give sources operational records
integration_proposals.proposal: Extend existing stored/composed/granted modes with source balances, capacity, quality, refill, ownership, donor connection, activation and compatibility rules. These are details of a source, not a universal new resource. Ordinary banking, outside amplification and revocable grants must differ.

integration_proposals.title: Separate progress, access and appraisal
integration_proposals.proposal: Preserve eight path parts, but let a person hold independent tracks: trained mastery, reservoir quality, body stage, oath acceptance, class identity and institutional grade. An arc can merge tracks or require two achievements, without assuming every series is an XP ladder.

integration_proposals.title: Split the parties and enforcement stages
integration_proposals.proposal: Keep all existing core/extra slots. Add payer, beneficiary, liable_target and claim_holder; enforcement.mode; truth_basis; evidence_channels; check_time; acceptance_gate; release_predicate; and versioned fulfillment terms. Consequences can harm a partner, duties can attach to an office and some bindings have no reward.

integration_proposals.title: Keep rules and exploits local, inspectable and saved
integration_proposals.proposal: Record source continuity/era, known rule version, actual trigger order and carrier policy. A lawful funny exploit stays possible where the world permits it. Save/reload duplication is a different event. A later patch or court ruling cannot be silently substituted for the terms already promised.
